title: Duran Duran Guitarist Andy Taylor Dies at 65 After Battle With Prostate Cancer
summary: The two-time GRAMMY winner was also a member of The Power Station and had a career as a solo artist.
body_markdown:
Andy Taylor, the former guitarist for[Duran Duran](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/duran-duran) , died November 23 at age 65 following a lengthy battle with prostate cancer, the legendary new wave band confirmed.


SiriusXM music channels, including[1st Wave (Ch. 33)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/1st-wave) , are paying tribute to Andy on air.


[1st Wave (Ch. 33) Classic alternative & new wave Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/1st-wave)


A two-time GRAMMY winner as a member of Duran Duran, Andy was also part of the supergroup The Power Station and enjoyed a solo career.


Duran Duran shared a joint statement on the band’s website following Andy’s death.


“Andy was there at the very beginning of our story. From the moment he arrived in Birmingham from the North East with a guitar and an unshakeable belief in what we could become, he brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music,” Simon Le Bon, Nick Rhodes, John Taylor and Roger Taylor wrote. “His playing drove the songs that took us around the world, and with a dry wit that was matched only by his wonderfully unsentimental, no-nonsense outlook on life he kept us grounded and gave the band its edge through the extraordinary years that followed.”


1st Wave host Richard Blade also paid tribute to Andy on social media:


“So, so sad. I wish it wasn’t true, but Andy Taylor from Duran Duran has passed away after a brave years-long battle with cancer. Talking bout it now on my show on SiriusXM 1st Wave,” Richard wrote.
